record.question: The advantage of a soft gelatine capsule over a hard gelatine capsule is that:
options: They can increase the rate of excretion of the drug
They can decrease the occurrence of adverse effects
They can hold oily and water-immiscible liquids
They can increase the rate of production
record.explanation: Answer C: They can hold oily and water-immiscible liquids. Soft gelatin capsules can contain oily, liquid, or semisolid fills that are unsuitable for conventional hard-shell capsules. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK562178/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
